doc.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11

title: Ages, Christian's birth date and Sbarbaro's real name
summary: Christian gives his birth date, April 1895; Sbarbaro spells his real name and explains his nickname.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: When did you play those parades, Mr. Christian? Oh, 1911, 1912. How long is it? 1910. When were you born? How old? I don't remember your birth date either. April 1895. April the 20th.
A couple of years older than Tony then.
I thought he was about 15 years old, but he was only a couple of years.
63. We used to bum together when we were kids. Yeah.
My right name is Sparbaro. S-B-A-R-B-A-R-O. Sparbaro.
And where did this other name come from?
Well, the fellas in the band started calling me Sparbaro for shot.
No, it doesn't mean a single thing. That doesn't mean, and it just stuck there.
